brief:
Settlers demolished a memorial to slain Al Jazeera journalist Shireen Abu Akleh in the occupied West Bank this week, Zeteo reported. Abu Akleh, a prominent Palestinian reporter, was killed in May 2022 during Israeli military operations in the Jenin refugee camp.

The destruction of the memorial occurred amid broader Israeli policies affecting Palestinians across occupied territory. The incident coincided with reports of collective punishment measures targeting West Bank communities as Israel's military operations continue.
dek: Zeteo’s weekly round-up of the stories you may have missed out of occupied Gaza and the West Bank, as Israel continues its genocidal war and apartheid policies.
title: Israeli settlers destroy Shireen Abu Akleh memorial in West Bank
